   - The vertical barrier at x = 47 spans from y = 5 to y = 28, blocking movement at this x-coordinate.

3. Move right to [8, 16] (just above the horizontal barrier).
4. Move right to [40, 16] (moving along y = 16).
5. Move down to [40, 13] (to reach the goal).
